ai.title: ensureDirectoryExists handles EEXIST race
ai.summary: ensureDirectoryExists in common/src/util/file.ts now catches EEXIST and retries with backoff. This fixes failures when Windows cloud filesystem drivers expose new directories with latency. sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts uses this helper instead of raw mkdir. Retry delays are 0, 10, 50, 100ms.

eli5.text: When the assistant tries to create a folder on Windows machines that use cloud-based file storage, the folder sometimes appears a few moments late, causing the creation to fail and interrupt your work. The assistant now waits briefly and checks again if the folder exists before giving up, so file-saving operations that previously errored out now complete successfully. You won't see any new buttons or options, but actions like editing or creating files in nested folders should stop failing unexpectedly on those Windows setups.

facts: On Windows, a single-leading-slash path uses Git Bash semantics because that is the shell exposed to agents; native absolute paths retain their drive or UNC prefix.
Git Bash paths start with one slash; two slashes already name a native Windows UNC path.
entries.title: SDK update: path-utils
entries.summary: SDK changes across 2 file(s) (+377/−9).

ai.title: SDK translates Git Bash paths before resolving file paths
ai.summary: The SDK file tools now translate Git Bash style paths to native Windows paths before resolving them, so an MSYS drive path like /c/Users is mapped to C:\Users inline, while a single-leading-slash path is resolved via cygpath.exe spawned from the detected Git for Windows bash. This fixes path resolution for agents that emit POSIX-style paths in the Git Bash shell the SDK exposes on Windows, where native absolute paths retain their drive or UNC prefix. The change is confined to the @codebuff/sdk packages/sdk path utilities and the windows-bash path translation module.
ai.evidence: Commit 1e69baf9 adds translateGitBashPath, isGitBashAbsolutePath, resetTranslationCache, and the WindowsShellPathDependencies type to sdk/src/tools/windows-bash.ts, and rewires resolveFilePathWithinProject, resolveFilePath, and getProjectPathLookupKeys in sdk/src/tools/path-utils.ts to call translateGitBashPath(filePath, dependencies) instead of passing filePath through path.isAbsolute directly.
ai.migration: No action required; existing SDK callers that rely on default dependencies continue to work, as the new behavior falls back to the original path when bash or cygpath is unavailable.
ai.unknowns: The diff shows the path translation layer and its tests but does not show which SDK consumers call run_terminal_command or the Desktop surfaces that consume the translated paths in production.

ai.title: MiniMax M3 withdrawn from Freebuff free models
ai.summary:
MiniMax M3 is withdrawn from Freebuff's free model picker rather than just un-premiumed, so it is removed from FREEBUFF_MODELS and added to FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS while its MINIMAX_M3_MODEL row and the base2-free-minimax-m3 agent allowlist entry are kept so already-live sessions keep running. A new model_unavailable gate code (410, endsTheSession false) and freebuffWithdrawnModelMessage(id) replace the prior silent coercion to the fallback, so released clients that still display and request M3 are refused at admission with a message naming a replacement model instead of being routed to another model without explanation. The README picker tables, CLI release README model list, and FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE in common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts are updated to no longer list MiniMax M3 as an available or unlimited free model.

Three other changes land in the same snapshot: the base2-free-minimax-m3 entry is deliberately retained in FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS with a clarifying comment so in-flight sessions drain instead of failing mid-turn; the full-tier branch of resolveFreebuffSessionModelForAccessTier stops resolving paused picks to FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID in favor of refusing withdrawn models at admission; and the FREEBUFF_GATE_CODES and session-type comment block in common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts documents that model_unavailable is terminal for the request but not session-ending, referencing issue #1801 as the retry-loop case it avoids.
ai.evidence: In common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts, the MINIMAX_M3_MODEL row's `premium` flag was set back to true and FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID was added to the FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS list, plus a new freebuffWithdrawnModelMessage(id) function returns '<name> is no longer available in Freebuff. We recommend using <replacement> instead.' by looking up SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS and DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID. In common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts, FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE was edited to state 'MiniMax M3 is unavailable.' instead of 'MiMo 2.5 and MiniMax M3 stay unlimited'. In common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts, the FREEBUFF_GATE_CODES table gained a new model_unavailable entry with status 410 and endsTheSession false, and resolveFreebuffSessionModelForAccessTier's full-tier branch replaced its silent pausing coercion with a comment stating that a withdrawn model is refused at admission with model_unavailable rather than resolved.
ai.migration: Users who still select MiniMax M3 in a released CLI or Desktop must switch to another model (DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 is recommended) since the pick is now refused at admission with a message instead of being silently rerouted.

changes.what: Withdrawn MiniMax M3 from Freebuff free mode by adding FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID to FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS, removing MINIMAX_M3_MODEL from FREEBUFF_MODELS, setting its premium flag to true, and adding the freebuffWithdrawnModelMessage(id) helper that renders a recommendation string.

Added a model_unavailable entry to FREEBUFF_GATE_CODES with status 410 and endsTheSession false, and updated resolveFreebuffSessionModelForAccessTier's full-tier branch to refuse withdrawn models at admission instead of silently coercing them to FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID.
Updated FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE to state that MiniMax M3 is unavailable rather than listing it as an unlimited free model.
Kept the base2-free-minimax-m3 entry in FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS with a comment explaining withdrawal is enforced at admission so live sessions drain.
